'''Juronus Opto''' was a [[human]] individual from [[Ardennia]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> active during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Opto wore a hermetically-sealed [[flight helmet]], a duster [[jacket]], and [[variable mag-grip boot]]s, and also carried a hidden [[hold-out blaster]].<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
